What we do

Bathrooms, showers and everything in between

From a complete refit of the whole room to a new shower enclosure, a fresh set of tiles or a new vanity unit.

Complete bathroom refits

The old suite stripped out and the room rebuilt with new sanitaryware, walls and flooring, ready to use.

See more

Shower enclosures

Quadrant and square enclosures fitted with the tray, the glass and the shower set up together.

Baths and shower screens

Straight and P-shaped shower baths with a glass screen, so one room gives you both.

Wall and floor tiling

Large format, wood-effect and mosaic feature tiling, cut and finished neatly around every fitting.

Waterproof wall panels

Why choose us

Why homeowners choose Staffordshire Bathrooms

A bathroom is judged on the details: the tile lines, the silicone and the way the panels meet. That is where the time goes.

Finishing you can see

Straight tile lines, neat silicone and boxing in that sits flush. Look closely at any photograph on this page.

Planned before we start

The layout, the suite and the finish are agreed up front, so the room is out of action for as short a time as possible.

Baths, showers or both

A P-shaped shower bath, a straight bath with a screen or a separate enclosure, whichever suits the size and shape of your room.

Help choosing what fits

Not sure where to start? Send a few photographs of your bathroom on WhatsApp and talk through the options before you buy anything.

Tiles or panels

Full wall and floor tiling, or waterproof marble-effect wall panels for a grout-free finish that wipes clean.

Local to Stafford

A Stafford business fitting bathrooms in homes across the county. Send your postcode to check we cover you.
